name: Guisando (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle based on the hoist and pointing to the centre, bearing a green chestnut tree.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 30 January 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 34 of 16 February 2001); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a red cloth with a white triangle bearing a green chestnut, its vertices at the ends of the staff and at the centre of the flag.

features.role: triangle from the hoist to the centre
